name: Hurlburt Field
description: Home of Air Force Special Operations Command and the 1st Special Operations Wing. Hurlburt Field is the hub of Air Force special operations forces, supporting global special operations missions.

currentNotifications.title: REAL ID Required for Base Access
currentNotifications.body: A REAL ID-compliant driver's license or equivalent is required for base access per DHS mandate.

gates.name: Main Gate
gates.notes: Primary 24/7 access point with visitor processing.

gates.name: Visitor Control Center (VCC)
gates.notes: Day passes and visitor registration. REAL ID required. Sponsor must email pre-approval for groups.
gates.address: Visitor Control Center, Hurlburt Field, FL 32544

resources.name: Riptide Dining Facility
resources.description: Primary DFAC supporting special operations forces with full meal service, a la carte options, and flight/ground meals. Multi-purpose facility with fitness equipment.
resources.hours: Mon-Fri: Breakfast 0600-0830, Lunch 1100-1300, Dinner 1630-1830; Weekends/Holidays: Brunch 0700-1300, Dinner 1630-1830
resources.address: 123 Howie Walters Rd, Bldg 91007, Hurlburt Field, FL 32544

resources.name: Hurlburt Main Exchange (BX)
resources.description: Full-service Exchange with retail, services, and food court options.

resources.name: Eglin Federal Credit Union
resources.description: Full-service credit union branch on base with ATM.

resources.name: Aderholt Fitness Center
resources.description: Main fitness facility with cardio, weights, group exercise, and sports amenities. 24/7 access available.
resources.hours: Mon-Fri 0530-2200; Sat 0800-1600; Sun 24/7; closed holidays/down days

resources.name: Commando Fitness Center
resources.description: Fitness facility supporting special operations personnel. 24/7 access available.

resources.name: Riptide Fitness Center
resources.description: Fitness facility co-located with Riptide DFAC. 24/7 access available.

resources.name: Unaccompanied Housing / Dorm Management
resources.description: Dormitory management and assignments for special operations personnel.

resources.name: Commando Inn (AF Lodging)
resources.description: Official temporary lodging and TLF. 24-hour front desk for arrivals.

resources.name: Military & Family Readiness Center (M&FRC)
resources.description: Relocation assistance, financial counseling, employment support, family programs, and Total Force readiness.
resources.address: Bldg 90213, 220 Lukasik Avenue, Hurlburt Field, FL 32544

resources.name: 1st Special Operations Force Support Squadron (1 SOFSS)
resources.description: Full MWR, dining, fitness, lodging, recreation, and family support programs supporting Air Force Special Operations Command.
resources.hours: See directory for individual facility hours

resources.name: Outdoor Recreation (ODR)
resources.description: Equipment rental, beachside facilities (KT's Kraken Tiki Bar), and recreational programs.

resources.name: Gator Lakes Golf Course
resources.description: 18-hole golf course with Oasis Café and pro shop.

resources.name: Beale Lanes Bowling Center
resources.description: Bowling alley with lanes and snack bar.

resources.name: 1st Special Operations Medical Group
resources.description: Primary care, specialty clinics, and TRICARE services supporting special operations forces.

primaryAction.title: Visitor Control Center (VCC)
primaryAction.address: Visitor Control Center, Hurlburt Field, FL 32544

sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: PCS orders, CAC, medical/dental records, marriage and birth certificates if applicable, and travel receipts for finance settlement.

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: Contact Commando Inn (850-884-7115) for initial arrival. Dormitory Management for unaccompanied housing. Family housing through Emerald Coast Military Housing.

sections.title: Quick Resources
sections.body: 1 SOFSS, M&FRC, and official Hurlburt sites for in-processing and special operations support.
